metadata.description:
There is nothing a well-placed bomb can’t clear up! Come and blow up obstacles and other players in Bomb it 1, the first game of this popular game serie! The competition becomes even more heated when explosives get involved, but they are a necessary tool in this game. Try to blow up labyrinth walls made from soda cans, cookies, and popcorn bags to reach your enemies and eliminate them with a big bang!

Bomb It 1, with its colorful and candy-filled world, offers hours of fun as its addictive gameplay keeps you hooked in front of the screen of your PC while you keep repeating to yourself, “One more level!” Cookie sandwiches, cupcakes, and many other delicious treats make up the walls of each level. As the player, your objective is to drop bombs in strategic locations to remove these sugary walls and clear a path to your main objective, the other characters. In Bomb It 1, you try to blow up every other character in the level and become the last man standing. Some cupcakes will be destroyed, but it is the price of becoming the sole survivor. To start the game, choose from one of the 4 characters. After choosing your character, you are ready to delve into the world of treats that can even satisfy a person with the biggest sweet tooth. Try not to get distracted by these delicious desserts because as soon as you arrive at the level, other characters will start placing bombs and clearing their paths. Use the arrow keys to move around and press the space bar to place a bomb. A bomb has a range of a certain number of blocks so once you drop your bomb, run. Getting caught in the explosion will hurt you and you will eventually die. A death bed made of sponge cake might sound appealing, but you are here to win! Place your bombs carefully and eliminate all others to win the levels!
